probes.name: packages importing libp2p (non-test src)
probes.cmd: git grep -lE "from '(libp2p|@libp2p/|@chainsafe/)" $REV -- 'packages/*/src/*.ts' ':!*.test.ts' | sed "s#^$REV:##" | cut -d/ -f2 | sort -u | tr '\n' ' '

probes.name: netlayer packages
probes.cmd: git ls-tree -d --name-only $REV packages/ | grep netlayer | sed 's#packages/##' | tr '\n' ' '; echo

probes.name: remotes/platform non-test files in ocap-kernel
probes.cmd: git ls-tree -r --name-only $REV packages/ocap-kernel/src/remotes/platform 2>/dev/null | grep -v test | wc -l

probes.name: initTransport/registry in node runtime
probes.cmd: git grep -hoE 'initTransport|NetlayerRegistry|netlayerRegistry' $REV -- packages/kernel-node-runtime/src | sort | uniq -c | tr -s ' ' | tr '\n' ';'

probes.name: transport engine file
probes.cmd: for f in packages/ocap-kernel/src/remotes/platform/transport.ts packages/netlayer/src/channel-netlayer.ts; do git cat-file -e $REV:$f 2>/dev/null && echo -n "$f:$(git show $REV:$f | wc -l) "; done; echo

probes.name: kernel-shims imports @libp2p/webrtc
probes.cmd: git grep -q "import '@libp2p/webrtc'" $REV -- packages/kernel-shims/src && echo yes || echo no

probes.name: node runtime runtime deps on libp2p
